title: Copilot reflection and telemetry - pilot
description: Derived assessments and filtered native telemetry. Project attribution and usage accounting remain unverified; raw spans are not usage totals.

options.content:
### Reflection + activity
Reviewed assessments and metadata-only telemetry for the selected project and time range.

**Accounting and telemetry project attribution are unverified.** Spans are observations, not billable calls or token totals. Missing labels stay `unattributed`. Daily assessment uses the separately enabled **Copilot Daily Session Review** job; results require reviewed publishing. Setup notes below are not live health signals.

panels.title: Assessed sessions
panels.description: Latest assessment revision per origin, project and session, created within the selected time range. Synthetic Azure smoke assessments are excluded. This is not a count of all Copilot sessions.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
CopilotAssessments_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| where Origin != 'synthetic_azure_model_smoke'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Origin, ProjectId, SessionId, Revision
| summarize arg_max(Revision, *) by Origin, ProjectId, SessionId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| summarize AssessedSessions=count()

panels.title: Observed spans
panels.description: Deduplicated incoming spans, not validated usage or distinct model calls. The sparkline shows span arrivals over the selected range. Invocation and model-call spans may overlap.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelSpans
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where tostring(Attributes['telemetry.origin']) == 'unverified_client'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TraceId, SpanId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend ProjectId=tostring(Attributes['project.id'])
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| summarize Spans=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Model labels seen
panels.description: Distinct nonempty response-model labels on observed spans, not a count of models available or verified model calls.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelSpans
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where tostring(Attributes['telemetry.origin']) == 'unverified_client'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TraceId, SpanId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend ProjectId=tostring(Attributes['project.id'])
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| extend Model=tostring(Attributes['gen_ai.response.model'])
| summarize ModelLabels=dcountif(Model, isnotempty(Model))

panels.title: Last observed span
panels.description: Latest span start time within the selected range, not collector heartbeat or process health. A historical range can intentionally show an old timestamp.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelSpans
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where tostring(Attributes['telemetry.origin']) == 'unverified_client'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TraceId, SpanId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend ProjectId=tostring(Attributes['project.id'])
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| summarize LastSpan=max(TimeGenerated)
| project LastSpan=tolong((LastSpan - datetime(1970-01-01)) / 1ms)

panels.title: Activity over time
panels.description: Deduplicated observed spans by start time. Counts describe telemetry volume only; overlapping invocation and model-call spans are not independent usage.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelSpans
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where tostring(Attributes['telemetry.origin']) == 'unverified_client'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TraceId, SpanId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend ProjectId=tostring(Attributes['project.id'])
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| summarize Spans=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Observed operations
panels.description: Span counts grouped by operation label. Missing labels are shown explicitly. These are not verified call totals.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelSpans
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where tostring(Attributes['telemetry.origin']) == 'unverified_client'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TraceId, SpanId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend ProjectId=tostring(Attributes['project.id'])
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| extend Operation=tostring(Attributes['gen_ai.operation.name'])
| extend Operation=iff(isempty(Operation), '(not labelled)', Operation)
| summarize Spans=count() by Operation
| order by Spans desc

panels.title: Assessment summaries
panels.description: Latest published reviewed revision per session, not live archive eligibility. Empty results mean no reviewed summaries match the selected filters; local assessments are not automatically published.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
CopilotAssessments_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| where Origin != 'synthetic_azure_model_smoke'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Origin, ProjectId, SessionId, Revision
| summarize arg_max(Revision, *) by Origin, ProjectId, SessionId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| project TimeGenerated, ProjectId, Outcome, Summary, Origin, Limitations, SessionEndedAt
| order by TimeGenerated desc

panels.title: Inspect data | freshness and individual spans

azureLogAnalytics.query:
CopilotAssessments_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| where Origin != 'synthetic_azure_model_smoke'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Origin, ProjectId, SessionId, Revision
| summarize arg_max(Revision, *) by Origin, ProjectId, SessionId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| summarize LastAssessment=max(TimeGenerated), EligibleRowsVisible=count() by ProjectId, Origin
| extend MinutesSinceAssessment=datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastAssessment)
| order by LastAssessment desc

panels.title: Incoming telemetry - raw spans, not usage totals

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelSpans
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where tostring(Attributes['telemetry.origin']) == 'unverified_client'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TraceId, SpanId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend ProjectId=tostring(Attributes['project.id'])
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| project TimeGenerated, ProjectId, Operation=tostring(Attributes['gen_ai.operation.name']), Model=tostring(Attributes['gen_ai.response.model']), InputTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), OutputTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']), CacheReadTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens']), DurationMs, TraceId, SpanId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100

panels.title: Pilot notes | privacy, accounting and analysis scope
Usage and reliability - not collecting verified totals

options.content:
### Reading the numbers
The background collector runs continuously. Reload VS Code Insiders to activate its global metadata export. This setup description is not a live health signal.

The cards and charts count **observed spans**, not validated usage totals. Invocation and model-call spans may overlap, so their token counts must not be summed. Model labels are observations, not verified model calls.

Project labels remain `unattributed` until native workspace identity is verified; selecting a named project cannot recover missing labels. Last span time indicates data freshness, **not current process health**.

The time picker filters assessment creation time and span start time. Assessment lookback is capped at 90 days; telemetry at 30 days. No data does not prove that the collector is healthy or stopped.

### Metadata only
VS Code Insiders is configured to send metadata from **all projects** after a window reload, with content and identity capture disabled. The local collector filters traces before persistence/upload and discards logs and aggregate metrics.

No prompts, replies, code, tool payloads, or identity fields are permitted in dashboard storage.

### Daily reflection is separate
**Copilot Daily Session Review** processes new archived sessions at **09:00 local time** within an explicitly approved local scope. An approved projects root includes future projects, with no backfill and one shared five-attempt daily budget. The first scheduled assessment is deferred until the next 09:00 run after installation.

Assessments stay local until a derived summary is manually reviewed and published. Published rows describe historical archived revisions, not live source eligibility. Telemetry arriving here does not mean conversations have been analyzed. Check local status for actual enablement and job health.
